label: Week ahead: a plan from the calendar, the Red folder record, the tested calendar rules and the desk's levels. Not advice, not a forecast; paper only.
lines: A short week: US markets closed Thursday, early close Friday. Expect thin trading around the holiday.
Prediction markets on the 9 Dec Fed decision: Kalshi Hike 25bps 91%, Polymarket 25 bps increase 92%. What traders pay, not a forecast of ours.
Before the print: PCE (Wednesday): the Cleveland Fed nowcast for October is core +0.27%, headline +0.31% month on month (as of 2026-11-20), a model's estimate, not the consensus.

From the 2022-24 first-print record: PCE (Wednesday): Core CPI for October printed 0.30% m/m (the Cleveland Fed's file of actual prints, read 2026-11-20). On the 2022-24 record a core CPI of 0.3% went with core PCE near 0.24% (fit on 36 months, typical miss ±0.07 pp): a descriptive fit on past months, not a forecast on the record.
The US data that move gold most: PCE (Wednesday).
Calendar rules the desk has tested that passed their bar: Wednesday: the last trading day before a US market holiday and a gotobi day. Paper only, each with its own forward record: not proven.
Rules tested and failed also fall on Friday: listed there so they are not chased.
